    Gemini explanation

    How to read this: These are global impurity-importance percentages, not SHAP values or explanations for one district. They do not show whether a feature raises or lowers a forecast, and they do not establish cause. Impurity importance can favor features with many categories. Gemini summarizes these model statistics; it does not calculate them.

    Model & Methodology Details

    Technical architecture, data provenance, and public-health advisory notices.

    System Provenance

    The Dengue Outbreak Prediction System combines historical dengue surveillance records, meteorological telemetry (temperature, precipitation from Open-Meteo), Earth observation metrics (Leaf Area Index — LAI), and autoregressive lag indicators.

    Model Architecture: RandomForest_log1p trained on chronological holdout data.
    Prediction Target: next_observed_report_cases
    Feature Count: 32 validated temporal, geographical, and lag variables.

    Clinical & Public-Health Disclaimer

    This system is an experimental machine learning decision-support prototype. It does not replace official epidemiological surveillance conducted by the National Centre for Vector Borne Diseases Control (NCVBDC), municipal health authorities, or certified laboratory diagnostics.
